hero.title: EPUB Conversion & eBook Creation Services
hero.lead: Reflowable and fixed-layout EPUB production for publishers, academic publishing organizations and digital-content teams.
paragraphs: EPUBTRANS provides eBook creation and EPUB conversion services to help publishers transform manuscripts, print-production files and existing content into digital publications.

Our services include reflowable and fixed-layout EPUB production, content structuring, navigation, styling, metadata preparation and related publishing-file workflows. Accessible EPUB and Read Aloud features can also be considered where included in the project scope.

Whether you are preparing a new eBook, converting an existing publication or updating digital publishing files, we can review your source materials and target requirements to define the appropriate production approach.

sections.title: EPUB Conversion Services for Digital Publishing

lead.text: Preparing a publication for digital reading involves more than changing its file extension.

An EPUB publication requires an appropriate content structure, navigation, styling, metadata and supporting assets. The production approach also depends on how readers are expected to use the content.
EPUBTRANS supports eBook creation and conversion for defined publishing requirements, including EPUB2 and EPUB3 outputs where applicable.

blocks.text: Reflowable EPUB allows text and content to adapt to different reading environments, screen sizes and reader preferences.
It is commonly suited to publications where the content can flow naturally without depending on a fixed page arrangement.
Typical use cases include:

items: Existing print titles being prepared for digital reading

blocks.text: Production may include heading structures, paragraph styles, navigation, internal links, image placement and other formatting elements.
The suitability of reflowable EPUB depends on the source content, tables, equations, images and required reading experience.
Fixed-layout EPUB retains a defined page composition instead of allowing all content to reflow.
This approach may be suitable for publications where the placement of text and images is an important part of the reading experience.
Typical use cases include:
Fixed-layout production requires assessment of page dimensions, image quality, text placement, reading order and target reading-system behavior.
It is not automatically the preferred format for every complex publication. Device limitations and accessibility requirements should be considered before selecting the format.
EPUBTRANS's documented service portfolio includes EPUB2 and EPUB3 production.
The required format version should be selected according to the publisher's specifications, intended distribution workflow, content requirements and supported reading environments.
EPUB3 supports a range of modern digital publishing features, but individual features and reading-system requirements must be reviewed before they are included in a project.
Conversion of eligible source content into an agreed EPUB format.
Source files may include Microsoft Word, Adobe InDesign/IDML, XML, HTML, PDF and associated publication assets.
The conversion approach is determined by source quality, content structure, complexity and output requirements.
Preparation of digital publication content using appropriate headings, sections, paragraph styles, lists and other structural elements.
Where applicable, production includes XHTML content, CSS styling and supporting publication assets.
The goal is to organize the source material according to the intended EPUB structure and project specification.
Preparation of EPUB navigation elements, including the table of contents, internal links and other applicable reading-navigation features.
The requirements depend on the publication structure and EPUB version.
Preparation and integration of publication elements such as images, figures, tables, captions, references and equations.
Complex material may require additional formatting, structural reconstruction or format-specific decisions.
Preparation of agreed eBook metadata, including relevant publication information supplied or approved by the publisher.
This may involve titles, contributors, language information, identifiers and other fields required by the target specification.
Cover images and other supporting assets are incorporated according to the approved brief.
Where supported and specifically commissioned, EPUB production may include Read Aloud workflows or synchronized text-and-audio features.
These requirements should be reviewed separately because audio assets, timing information, content structure and reading-system compatibility can affect production.
Read Aloud EPUB is not automatically included with standard eBook conversion and should not be confused with producing a standalone audiobook.

lead.text: The appropriate format depends on the content and the intended reading experience.

items: Readers should be able to adjust text presentation.
The publication structure can adapt to different screen sizes.
A fixed page arrangement is not essential to understanding the content.
Page design is central to the publication.
Text and illustrations have specific spatial relationships.
Visual composition needs to remain consistent.
The intended reading environment supports the required layout behavior.

blocks.text: For some projects, a source publication designed for print may need adjustments before it works effectively as a digital book.
We can review representative pages and discuss the suitable EPUB format before production begins.

sections.title: Source Files We Can Assess for EPUB Conversion

lead.text: The quality and completeness of source materials influence the conversion process.
Depending on the project, EPUBTRANS can assess:

items: Existing EPUB files requiring revision or updating
Publisher style guides and production specifications

lead.text: Editable, well-structured source files generally provide more flexibility during EPUB production.

blocks.text: PDF files can be reviewed for EPUB conversion, but a PDF does not necessarily contain the logical structure needed for a reflowable eBook.
Page-based layouts, columns, text fragments, figures and reading order may require reconstruction.
Scanned or image-based PDFs can introduce additional text-extraction and correction requirements.
PDF-to-EPUB work should therefore be assessed according to source quality and expected output rather than treated as a simple automated conversion.

lead.text: Deliverables are defined according to the target format and agreed scope.

blocks.text: A reflowable or fixed-layout EPUB package in the agreed version and production specification.
Associated XHTML/HTML, CSS, images and other supporting resources where included in the delivery package.
The agreed table of contents, navigation structure and publication metadata included in the EPUB.
A validation checklist, issue report or test summary may be supplied where the corresponding checks are included and completed.
Additional source files, intermediate assets or distribution-specific outputs must be confirmed during project planning.
We review the manuscript or source publication, available assets, intended EPUB version, layout requirements and target distribution specifications.
Potential conversion challenges are identified before confirming the production scope.
The source material is organized or adapted for the selected EPUB approach.
This may include reviewing headings, reading order, images, tables, navigation requirements and publication metadata.
The content is converted and assembled using the appropriate structural, styling and packaging requirements.
Reflowable and fixed-layout workflows are adapted according to the publication design and target output.
Relevant technical, structural and visual checks are performed as defined by the project requirements.
Review may include navigation, content structure, image handling, internal references and layout behavior in agreed reading environments.
Agreed corrections are incorporated through the defined review process.
The final EPUB package and any supporting deliverables are prepared for handoff according to the approved specifications.

lead.text: An EPUB file must meet the applicable technical requirements of its intended format and publishing workflow.
Depending on the project, relevant checks may include:

items: Technical validation against the specified EPUB requirements
Review in agreed reading systems or applications

lead.text: Validation tools can identify technical errors, but automated checks alone do not establish that every publication element renders correctly or that the eBook is fully accessible.
The validation tools, test environments, review stages, acceptance criteria and reporting requirements should be defined in the project scope.
No particular retailer or reading-system acceptance is guaranteed without verifying the relevant requirements and the final deliverable.
Accessibility is an important consideration in digital publishing, particularly when publications must support diverse reading needs or meet specified accessibility requirements.
EPUBTRANS's documented services include accessible EPUB-related production.
Depending on the project, activities may involve:

items: Logical content structure and heading hierarchy
Alternative text integration when supplied or commissioned
Accessible treatment of images, tables and complex content
Applicable structural and format-specific accessibility checks

lead.text: Accessibility production and testing requirements are determined by the target specification, EPUB version, source materials and agreed acceptance criteria.
An EPUB file passing general technical validation does not automatically establish compliance with an accessibility standard.
Explore Digital Accessibility Services

sections.title: What Affects EPUB Conversion Scope & Schedule?

blocks.text: Well-organized editable content can require a different production process from unstructured PDFs, incomplete source packages or scanned publications.
Layout choice influences content preparation, formatting, visual review and target reading-system requirements.
Tables, equations, figures, footnotes, cross-references, special characters and complex publication structures may require additional work.
Alternative text, accessible tables, synchronized audio and other specialist requirements can affect the production and testing scope.
EPUB version, platform-specific instructions, test environments, requested review cycles and validation deliverables influence the work involved.
We assess these factors before confirming production scope, pricing or delivery arrangements.

lead.text: EPUB production may form part of a wider publishing or content-transformation workflow.

blocks.text: Book and journal page composition and layout preparation for print and digital publishing.
Structured-content preparation and XML conversion for applicable publishing workflows.
Accessibility-related production and remediation for EPUB, PDF and other supported document formats.
Preparation or reconstruction of source documents that may need further conversion before EPUB production.
These services can be discussed separately or combined where the project requirements call for related production activities.

EPUB conversion is the process of preparing existing manuscripts or publication content as a structured EPUB digital publication. Depending on the source and target requirements, this may involve content reconstruction, styling, navigation, metadata and technical checks.

groups.title: What is the difference between reflowable and fixed-layout EPUB?

blocks.text: Reflowable EPUB allows text and content to adapt to different reading environments. Fixed-layout EPUB preserves a defined page arrangement. The appropriate option depends on publication content, design and target reading systems.

groups.title: Can EPUBTRANS convert Word files into EPUB?

blocks.text: Microsoft Word is among the documented source formats for EPUB production. The manuscript structure, images, tables and other elements are reviewed before confirming scope.

groups.title: Can you convert PDF files into EPUB?

blocks.text: PDF files can be assessed for conversion. However, page-based content may require structural reconstruction, especially for reflowable EPUB. The effort depends on source quality and layout complexity.

groups.title: Do you support EPUB2 and EPUB3?

blocks.text: EPUBTRANS's documented portfolio includes EPUB2 and EPUB3 production. The required version and compatibility expectations should be confirmed for each project.

groups.title: Can you create fixed-layout EPUB for illustrated books?

blocks.text: Fixed-layout EPUB is part of the documented service portfolio. Suitability depends on the publication design, source assets, reading-system requirements and agreed output specification.

groups.title: Can EPUBTRANS produce accessible EPUB files?

blocks.text: Accessibility-related EPUB production can be scoped for supported requirements. The target accessibility specification, manual review, validation and any conformance assessment must be confirmed before making a compliance claim.
Technical validation can be included as a defined production activity. The tool, version, checks, reporting requirements and handling of any identified issues should be agreed in advance.

groups.title: Can you add Read Aloud functionality?

blocks.text: Read Aloud workflows are included in EPUBTRANS's documented portfolio where scoped. Availability, audio assets, synchronization requirements and compatible output formats need to be confirmed for the specific project.

groups.title: What information is needed for an EPUB conversion quote?

blocks.text: Please provide a sample manuscript or source publication, approximate page or title volume, desired EPUB format, target distribution requirements, relevant style or accessibility specifications and preferred schedule.
